title: Retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook 2-1/2-Inch pull-out solid brass Carolina Allied Brass
description:
Keep coats, robes, and towels close at hand with a retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inches of hanging space, then pushes back in to stay out of the way—ideal for tight bath or closet areas. Coordinates with the Carolina collection for matching Carolina traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Retractable pull-out rod: 2-1/2 inches of hanging space
- Wall mount hook/garment hook helps save floor space
- Solid brass construction
- Holds up to 15 lb
- Swap the supplied knob tip for your own cabinet knob (optional)

Specs & Installation:
- Size: 3.75-inch W x 1.75-inch H x 1.75-inch L; 1-inch projection when retracted
- Fits standard interior walls
- Drilling required: 3/4-inch diameter hole through drywall + three small holes
- Hardware included: 6/32 toggles
- Assembly required: no

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
